title: Long run, 3 climb loops on Paros
coachNotes: Climb cap lifted: the old HR 142 was reverse-engineered from the ramp budget, not from you. Climb at 89-93% LTHR (160-167), strong hike or run, RPE 6-7. Uphill is concentric so this is ITB-neutral, which is exactly why it is the lever we are using. Descents are NOT repriced: short strides, high cadence, no braking, poles if you have them. Stop the day at any lateral knee signal, the remaining loops are optional and the load target is not. Start by 06:30, Paros heat will inflate HR without adding fitness, so if it is hot judge the climbs by effort and let HR sit above range. Sunday go/no-go: if this comes in above 190, or ITB speaks at all, Sunday drops to 55 flat.
